consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance on December 28, 1980, was strong, particularly in the first half of the show. Standout moments include impressive versions of 'Franklin's Tower,' 'Bird Song,' and 'The Other One,' showcasing Jerry's skill and Phil's prominent bass work.
